_bob.plan: W7b, docs/COMFYUI.md track C, the second Omni control mode (D12, measured at G8)
_bob.purpose: W7 with the control signal reduced from a sampled point cloud to the block-out's three proportions, so a generated asset keeps the footprint a layout was composed around without any mesh leaving Blender.
_bob.derived_from: mesh_geom_ctrl.json (W7), with Hy3DOmniPointGenerate replaced by Hy3DOmniBBoxGenerate and the Trellis2LoadMesh control dropped; the node defaults follow Hunyuan3D-Omni/inference.py:infer_bbox (50 steps, guidance 4.5, box_v 1.01, mc_level 0).
deviations_from_source: auto_bbox is FALSE, which is the whole point of the graph. True makes the node estimate the proportions from the conditioning image's silhouette, which is a guess about a shape Bob already knows exactly; false takes bbox_length / bbox_height / bbox_depth, and Bob binds them from the proxy's own bounding box. The auto path is still reachable through the same title and is what G8 scores as the null.
octree_resolution is 256 rather than the node's 512, for W7's reason: 512 returns roughly 700,000 faces and Bob's next step is a 4,000-face budget either way.

No mesh loader at all. Hy3DOmniBBoxGenerate takes no control_mesh socket, so this is the one Omni route that uploads nothing, and therefore the one that cannot hit the mesh-transport failure G7 found over MCP.

Trellis2ExportTrimesh plus Preview3D is W7's tail unchanged, because the exporter is what converts the pack's internal Z-up to glTF Y-up and is the only one that reports its path in a form Bob can fetch.
_bob.requires_pack: ComfyUI-Hy3D-Omni (Rizzlord, NO license file, last push 2025-10-03) plus ComfyUI-TRELLIS2 for the mesh export
_bob.requires_models: tencent/Hunyuan3D-Omni, 13.5 GB, and it needs tools/scripts/comfy_omni_fix.py run once or the control signal is silently random
_bob.notes: The three numbers are [length, height, width] in the CONTROL GLB's frame, not Blender's: the encoder turns them into eight corners spanning [-d/2, d/2] on each axis (hy3dshape/models/conditioners/omni_encoder.py:bbox_to_corners), and every other Omni route feeds that encoder a signal in glTF Y-up. core.gen_assets.control_bbox is the one place that mapping lives, measured rather than assumed. The result comes back needing gen_assets.CONTROL_RETURN_TURN, exactly as W7's does and for the same reason: same exporter, one glb write. Omni takes NO text prompt, so the artist's words reach this graph only through the reference image.
